audit.title: Independent code review — blind release audit

findings.title: SSRF and Local File Inclusion in ImageDownloader
findings.claim: Multimodal image downloading allows arbitrary URL fetching without protocol validation or IP address filtering.
findings.risk: Local file exfiltration (e.g. file:///etc/passwd) and cloud metadata token theft (http://169.254.169.254/) via multimodal prompt injection.
findings.recommendation: Restrict URL schemes to http/https and enforce private/link-local IP filtering prior to connection.

findings.title: Raw SQLException and SQL Diagnostic Leakage in JDBC Stores
findings.claim: JDBC store operations rethrow raw java.sql.SQLException or propagate unredacted SQL diagnostics.
findings.risk: Table schemas, database query structures, and connection failure diagnostics leak up the stack to callers.
findings.reproduction: Trigger a constraint violation or closed connection during store operation and inspect unmapped SQLException.
findings.recommendation: Map all SQLException instances into typed PersistenceException with sanitized diagnostics.

findings.title: Gradle Strict Task Dependency Validation Failures
findings.claim: verify060Architecture and verifyPr encounter implicit task dependency errors under strict validation.
findings.risk: CI or clean daemon verification fails under Gradle 9.0 strict execution rules.
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit task dependencies via dependsOn or use typed Provider/TaskProvider wiring.

findings.title: Permissive Default Policy Engine in EngineComponentFactory
findings.claim: Defaults to LegacyPermissivePolicyEngine when no policy engine is configured.
findings.rationale: Retained for 0.4.x standalone backwards compatibility; 0.6.0 documentation directs users to governedPolicyFor.
findings.remediationPlan: Mark LegacyPermissivePolicyEngine as @Deprecated with removal in 1.0.0.

findings.title: Hardcoded Allow at BEFORE_TOOL_RESULT_REINJECTION
findings.risk: Tool results cannot be selectively blocked by policy rules before reaching LLM provider.
findings.rationale: DLP filters sanitize tool results before provider ingestion, providing defense-in-depth.
findings.remediationPlan: Extend PolicyEngine SPI to evaluate reinjection policies in 0.7.0.

findings.title: Unredacted Exception Recording in OpenTelemetry Spans
findings.claim: span.recordException is invoked with raw throwable instances.
findings.risk: Sensitive tokens in exception messages could be exported to telemetry collectors.
findings.rationale: Standard OTel practice; sensitive headers and payloads are already masked at HTTP layer.
findings.remediationPlan: Pass exception messages through Redactor.sanitize before recording.

findings.title: Weak Fallback Assertion in ProviderTck for Vision/Structured Content
findings.claim: ProviderTck falls back to assertNotNull when expectedContent is null.
findings.risk: A provider returning empty or corrupted payload could satisfy the TCK.
findings.rationale: All official providers have dedicated provider-level tests asserting exact response content.
findings.remediationPlan: Add strict non-empty content assertions in ProviderTck.

findings.title: Vacuous Ciphertext Assertions in JdbcApprovalContinuationStoreTest
findings.claim: Test uses assertNotNull on encrypted columns rather than validating entropy or ciphertext format.
findings.risk: Storage of plaintext or corrupt ciphertext could pass the column assertion.
findings.rationale: Roundtrip decryption is asserted in the same test suite.
findings.remediationPlan: Assert that raw column content does not contain plaintext data.

findings.title: Shell Step Command Policy Evaluates Binary Path Only
findings.claim: Policy evaluation checks only the executable binary name without inspecting command-line flags.
findings.recommendation: Support argument-aware regex policies for shell step authorization.

findings.title: Manifest Test Coupled to Whitespace-Free JSON Substring
findings.claim: Tests assert exact raw string matches instead of parsing JSON AST.
findings.recommendation: Use JSON structure comparison in manifest serialization tests.

findings.title: Misleading Test Class Name ShutdownHookTest
findings.claim: Tests programmatic worker shutdown rather than JVM shutdown hooks.
